parsed.reply: No, it is not an error! «Producir comezón» is standard Spanish for what an itch does — literally "to produce an itch." In Spanish dictionaries, verbs of physical sensation often use the third person to describe what the body feels.
followUps: Why does it use «me» instead of «mi»?
